source: False Telemetry / Phantom Fault System specification (2026-10-06)
note: THE ONE SOURCE of the facilitator's false telemetry templates. A phantom alert LOOKS like a fault to the room — a code, a name, a symptom, a severity, a displayed decay rate — and is not one: it lives in state.false_alerts, never in a sector's faults, so nothing decays, nothing is consumed, nothing can be repaired and nothing is paid. Its code must be one no real fault carries (F-7xx; the engine refuses a collision). Only COM is told, privately, that it is false; COM withdraws it with a PUBLISH CORRECTION on the existing City Broadcast. `display_reward` is the REPAIR REWARD line the card prints so the card reads like every other; it is never paid.
